sloka: दह्यमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रासादं हरियूथपः ।स राक्षसशतं हत्वा वज्रेणेन्द्र इवासुरान् ।अन्तरिक्षे स्थितः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ५.४३.१९।।।।
transliteration: dahyamānaṁ tato dṛṣṭvā prāsādaṁ hariyūthapaḥ ।sa rākṣasaśataṁ hatvā vajreṇendra ivāsurān ।antarikṣe sthitaḥ śrīmānidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 5.43.19।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter fire was generated (through friction) and with if the palace blazed. Hanuman saw the palace burning. He killed a hundred demons there as Indra killed demons with his thunderbolt. (The whirling pillar that generated fire apeared like a thunderbolt) Later he stood in the air and proclaimed this:
